title: Right to freedom of movement
question: What does Constitution 1999 section 41 say about right to freedom of movement?
shortAnswer: Constitution 1999 s.41 — Right to move freely, reside anywhere in Nigeria; no expulsion from Nigeria.
legalExplanation:
**Section 41 of the Constitution 1999** provides:

Right to move freely, reside anywhere in Nigeria; no expulsion from Nigeria

This provision empowers Constitution 1999 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
reviewNotes: Approved after review from Constitution 1999 s.41. Needs plain-language review and verification against official gazette.
